title: Find your way around
summary: Go from a question to a useful guide, and return to where you left off.
benefit: Keep the instructions close while you work.
outcome: You can find a guide, jump to a section and share a direct link.

sections.title: Choose a guide
paragraphs: Start on the documentation home page. Guides are grouped around what you want to do. Each card gives you a title, a short summary and the kind of guide: task, explanation or reference.
Use Find a guide to filter titles and summaries. Clear the search to see every published guide again. Only guides that are ready to read appear here.

flow.entry: Open a guide from the documentation home page.

steps.action: Choose a heading under On this page.
steps.result: The guide scrolls to that section and its address gains a heading anchor.

steps.action: Copy the page address from your browser.
steps.result: Your link opens the same guide at the same section, with no sign-in required.

flow.completion: The section link remains usable after a refresh. Your browser's Back and Forward buttons retrace your navigation.
flow.correction: Choose another section, use Back, or return to Documentation through the breadcrumb.

sections.title: Browse on a phone
paragraphs: Choose Browse guides in the header to open the guide list on a narrow screen. Choose a guide to open it and close the list. You can also choose Close guides or press Escape to close the list and return focus to its button.
The guide itself scrolls as a normal page. The On this page links stay above the instructions on smaller screens.

sections.title: Keep your place

callout.title: Your boards stay private
callout.text: Documentation is public. Reading these pages does not open a board or require an account.

paragraphs: Choose Open app in the header or at the bottom of the page when you are ready to use your boards. Your normal sign-in and board permissions still apply there.
